items.prompt: Implement `handleReliably(message, seen, effect)` with the same skip-if-seen behaviour keyed on `message.id`, but with one more rule: if `effect` throws, the key must NOT stay recorded and the error must propagate, so a later redelivery gets another chance. tests.description: a successful first delivery returns true
tests.expr: const seen = {}; expect(handleReliably({ id: "m1" }, seen, () => {})).toBe(true)

tests.description: a duplicate after success is skipped
tests.expr: let n = 0; const seen = {}; const eff = () => { n++; }; handleReliably({ id: "m1" }, seen, eff); expect(handleReliably({ id: "m1" }, seen, eff)).toBe(false); expect(n).toBe(1)

tests.description: a failing effect propagates the error
tests.expr: const seen = {}; expect(() => handleReliably({ id: "m1" }, seen, () => { throw new Error("boom"); })).toThrow()

tests.description: after a failure the redelivery is processed
